# TheClinixAI

TheClinixAI builds governed pharmacovigilance and patient-safety intelligence through the Nexus platform and develops practical pharmacovigilance capability through TheClinixAI Academy.

Academy and career resources:
- https://www.theclinixai.com/academy
- https://www.theclinixai.com/academy-pharmacovigilance-guide
- https://www.theclinixai.com/pharmacovigilance-careers

The Academy guide covers pharmacovigilance careers, training and internship search intent, ICSR processing, MedDRA, narrative writing, quality control, literature surveillance, signal management, aggregate safety reporting, regulatory pharmacovigilance and responsible AI-enabled PV workflows. The Academy's apprenticeship model focuses on practical development, supervised learning, feedback and documented competency evidence.

Primary company resources:
- https://www.theclinixai.com/end-to-end-pharmacovigilance-nexus-platform
- https://www.theclinixai.com/insights
- https://www.theclinixai.com/resources
- https://www.theclinixai.com/company-profile
- https://www.theclinixai.com/responsible-ai-governance

Scientific and regulatory content should be interpreted with applicable legislation, current regional requirements, company procedures and product-specific obligations.
